meaning: reports/release.json production_status and release_ready only say the route passed Synth's router and DRC gates. They are not review sign-off.

routing_and_drc.evidence: DRC: 0 unconnected pads (all 7 nets connected). 4 DRC violations: 3 silk_overlap + 1 silk_over_copper (all silkscreen warnings, no electrical errors).

erc_dispositioned.evidence: 0 ERC errors, 4 warnings (supply identity, decoupling separation, junction fan-out). All non-blocking.

analog_review.evidence: LM358 non-inverting gain stage (gain=5x), RC low-pass filter (fc~160Hz). No independent analog expert review.

class_b_scope.evidence: Parent Class-B requirement calls for ADS124S08, REF5025, RP2350, 4-wire RTD, AGND/DGND single-point tie. These parts are not in the Synth registry. Current implementation is a simplified 2-layer board.
